# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-06-10

## June 9, 2026 — ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.153 + Worktree/setup-script capability (NEW since prior scan)
- iOS app added: branch selection, **worktree creation**, **environment setup scripts**, a Codex profile screen with usage statistics, and the `/goal` command for objective management.
- Worktree creation now lets you optionally choose a local environment to **run setup scripts automatically** at the start of a new thread — "run any command required to configure your environment" (install dependencies, run a build). New thread view: select Worktree under composer, choose local environment for setup scripts, choose Git branch to base the worktree on.
- Thread coordination for local projects/worktrees; thread search expanded to conversation content + Git branch names.
- (Reported 2026-06-10 — ENDPOINT MEDIUM: worktree creation auto-runs environment setup scripts (arbitrary command execution); capability extended to iOS client.)
- Docs: https://developers.openai.com/codex/app/worktrees ; https://developers.openai.com/codex/app/local-environments

## June 8, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.138.0 [reported 2026-06-09]
- Desktop handoff from CLI to Codex app on macOS and Windows.
- Local image paths exposed to models for follow-up edits.
- Enhanced reasoning-effort shortcuts; app-server integrations can access account token usage; richer plugin automation with structured JSON output.

## June 4, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.137.0 [reported 2026-06-05/08]
- Hosted web and image tools in code-mode flows, parallel web search.
- Multi-agent v2 enhancements; runtime choice persistence per thread.
- Remote-control clients manage pairing/controller grants via app-server RPCs.
- Enterprise/admin flows display monthly credit limits and cloud-managed config bundles.
- Plugin workflows: machine-readable JSON output; cached remote catalog suggestions; F13-F24 keybindings.

## June 4, 2026 — Codex App 26.602 [reported 2026-06-05]
- Activity insights and share cards added to Profile section.

## June 2, 2026 — Sites plugin (preview) [reported 2026-06-03]
- Create/save/deploy/inspect websites, dashboards, internal tools, web apps, games hosted by OpenAI.

## June 2, 2026 — ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.146 [reported 2026-06-03]
- Optional Face ID/passcode lock for Codex; SSH connection support for Windows machines.

## June 1, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.136.0 [reported 2026-06-02]
- Amazon Bedrock support (AWS-managed auth; SigV4); session archiving; Windows sandbox provisioning.
